[NDBG.5.2] **The arrays are caller-owned** — free `timetags`, each
`rule_names[i]`, and `rule_names` with `ds_free()` ([IALC.4.3]), not the C
library's `free()`, which is a different allocator under an allocator override.
The call returns `DS_OK` with
`n == 0` for non-logical facts, unknown fact ids, or a backend with no exposed
truth-maintenance. It is meaningful only while paused ([NDBG.1.2]).
